$comment: Files under public/assets that ship WITHOUT an art/manifest.json row because they are third-party assets with their licence text next to them (read by tools/licence/audit.mjs). Every entry needs a licence file that exists; 'licencePerFile' maps each file to its own licence text ({family} = file stem up to the first '-'). 'placeholder: true' entries are dev stand-ins: `audit.mjs --release` fails while they are still shipped. Add an entry only with the licence file committed next to the asset.
